# PrintReady AI — full brief

PrintReady AI is a vendor-neutral weekly printability benchmark for AI 3D generators (Meshy, Tripo, Rodin/Hyper3D, Hunyuan3D, Trellis, Hitem3D/Hi3D).

## Scoring weights
Watertight 20 · Manifold 15 · Non-manifold edges 10 · Self-intersections 10 · Thin walls 10 · Slice success 20 · Print time 5 · Support volume 10.
Hard fail: score capped at 39 if not watertight OR slicer fails.

## Phase-1 dry-run results (2026-10-30 ET) — TEST MESHES ONLY
These are pipeline validation meshes, not AI generator outputs.
- n01_closed_cube: 100 (control)
- pd_capsule / pd_cylinder / pd_icosphere / pd_torus: 100 (controls)
- n05_thin_plate: 90 (0.25 mm thin-wall penalty)
- n04_intersecting_tets: 90 (self-intersection penalty)
- n02_open_cube: 39 hard-fail (not watertight)
- n03_internal_wall: 39 hard-fail (non-manifold)

Real AI-generator leaderboard scores are coming soon after free-tier generator runs.
